using ull = unsigned long long;

const ull INF = 17446744073709551616ULL;

ull mod, n, k;

ull fac[250005], inv[250005];

        if (b & 1) {
            res = (res * base) % mod;
        }
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

inline ull comb(int a, int b) {
    if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0;
    return (((fac[a] * inv[b]) % mod) * inv[a - b]) % mod;
}

inline ull solve() {

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * static_cast<ull>(i)) % mod;
    }
    inv[n] = qpow(fac[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * static_cast<ull>(i + 1)) % mod;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        dp[1][i] = inv[i];
    }

    ull result = (dp[1][n] * comb(k, 1)) % mod;
    int maxIter = min(17, static_cast<int>(k));

    for (int iter = 2; iter <= maxIter; ++iter) {

        }
        result = (result + dp[iter][n] * comb(k, iter)) % mod;
    }

    result = (result * fac[n]) % mod;
    return result;

int main() {
